Regional notes from the September leadership sync.

EMEA: The partner program contributed roughly a third of new bookings in Q3. The team expects continued growth but flags that partner margins are lower than direct sales.

North America: August was unusually slow because two large deals slipped into September. September closed strong, so the quarter still finished above plan.

APAC: Revenue fell for the second consecutive month in August. Hiring is the main constraint; marketing-sourced pipeline is healthy.

Note: September figures for APAC are preliminary and may be revised after the finance close.
